job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

prior_reviews.reason: This is a Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions RFP, not KCERA’s. Its three-year term and two optional one-year renewals cannot establish KCERA’s contract term or extension provisions.
quotes: The City of Los Angeles Fire & Police Pensions (“LAFPP” or the “Plan”) is seeking proposals from qualified certified public accounting firms

LAFPP intends to award a three-year contract with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year. The Board may choose to exercise its authority to extend this relationship beyond the three-year contract term through two one-year renewals.
